comparison.objective: Stop a spinning centrifuge, open it safely, remove a tube and rack it; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Button actuation, hinged-lid opening and tube extraction/insertion versus fine tool alignment, rotary tuning and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Rotor stopped before opening and tube upright in rack versus repeated acceptable carriage stops without hard-stop contact.
comparison.reason: Both include guarded control actuation, but centrifuge interlock sequencing and tube handling are not damper adjustment. Candidate has undeclared rebound, overload and drift limits.
